name: debug-id-generator
title: Debug ID Generator
description: Generate unique, validation-friendly test data for forms and tracking QA: national IDs, phones, IBANs, and plus-addressed debug emails.
author: sierakk

commands.name: debugnumbersgenerator
commands.title: Debug ID Generator
commands.description: Browse and copy generated test IDs, phones, and debug emails for the selected country.

commands.name: paste-debug-email
commands.title: Paste Debug Email
commands.description: Paste a unique plus-addressed email based on your configured tester email into the focused field.

preferences.name: mainCountry
preferences.title: Choose your main country
preferences.description: Your country will be displayed first after opening

preferences.name: testerEmail
preferences.title: Your email
preferences.description: Base inbox used for plus-addressed debug emails, e.g. you@gmail.com

preferences.name: emailPrefix
preferences.title: Email debug prefix
preferences.description: Optional campaign/debug prefix added before the random tag, e.g. gtm or qa

preferences.name: emailTagMode
preferences.title: Email tag mode
preferences.description: How the unique plus-tag is generated

preferences.name: emailTagLength
preferences.title: Email tag length
preferences.description: Length of the random part of the plus-tag (4-12). Ignored in timestamp mode.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
